scenes.text: Meet CareerSetu. Bridging higher education to meaningful careers. Moving students from passive chatbot answers to measurable readiness and action.
In seconds, Aarav calibrates his degree, verified Python, SQL, and FastAPI stack, and locks onto a Data Engineering trajectory.
Zero black-box mystery. The explainable Readiness Engine scores six weighted dimensions across technical skills, practical projects, academics, and communication.
High-speed set intersections match Aarav to Data Systems Engineer, explaining the fit while pinpointing exact deficits like Apache Spark and Docker.
Missing skills become a ninety-day execution roadmap across three phases. Completing a weekly lab recalibrates his readiness score in real time.
Curated opportunity matching connects verified skills directly to industry internships and new-grad engineering roles with transparent qualification criteria.
The Evidence-Grounded Resume Copilot transforms weak bullets into metric-driven impact statements, strictly anchored to real achievements with zero hallucinated claims.
Adaptive multi-turn AI mock interviews test system depth and SQL optimization, delivering instant STAR rubric scorecards for accuracy and clarity.
With cohort-wide analytics for universities and placement teams, CareerSetu turns student aspiration into actionable readiness.
